method: Two abstract-only adjudications by reading the sampled arXiv abstracts. The set includes all seven papers where the four L1 relevance decisions differed, plus one high-value proxy and one unanimous low control. It is disagreement-enriched, not a random audit sample.

labels.relevant_to_agenda: Materially studies agent reliability, agent evaluation/assurance, harness/runtime, MCP/governance, tool use, or long-running agent workflows. General LLM, RAG, or AI work without a material agentic connection is false.
labels.empirical_evidence: Abstract reports experiments, measurements, benchmark results, or systematic observations; theoretical framing with empirical predictions/evidence also counts true.
